parameters.name: FileSystemId
parameters.description: The ID of the file system.

parameters.name: MountTargetName
parameters.description: The name of the mount target.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries returned per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens describe-mount-targets --ens-region-id cn-beijing-cmcc --file-system-id c50f800000 --mount-target-name TestMountPath --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens DescribeMountTargets --region cn-hangzhou --MountTargetName TestMountPath --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --FileSystemId c50f800000 --EnsRegionId 'cn-beijing-cmcc'
